q1.question: Will full autonomy overspend?
q1.answer: No. Non-overridable budget caps, rate limits and a circuit breaker auto-pause and roll back on anomalies; every spend passes risk control first.

q2.question: Can I start without full autonomy?
q2.answer: Yes. Begin at L1 advisory and approve every action — you control how fast autonomy is granted.

q3.question: Can it hold CPA with little data?
q3.answer: That's a physical limit — no one can, human or AI. When reliability (DRS) is too low, it switches to leading indicators or holds still, rather than guessing.

q4.question: Is the creative AI-generated? Will the brand drift?
q4.answer: Logo and fixed elements are composited by code, never generated; pre-launch checks verify palette and platform policy, and block anything that fails.
